name: Stupid Babies
desc:
⭐ Wanna be a stupid baby that can run around? You've come to the right place!

Recent Update:
- 🪙 A currency has been added, coins will now spawn randomly from the sky. You can also buy coins from the shop using Robux.
- 🛒 A shop has been added, you can now buy as much gears as you wish from the shop, get to spending! (Gears, Robux, coins)
- 🎁 Gifting, you can gift other players game passes!
- We've added three new songs!
- Optimized some very old code, lag should be less common now :)
- Added confirmation before being teleported to VC Servers
- We've Improved UI position and colors slightly

Credits:
@LINDON55 & @tackyv - SCRIPTING

[Special thanks to mrflimflam and jokerkid5898 for playing!]
